The inventory of shipped components (SBOM) is generated and versionable.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Command | `syft scan dir:. -o cyclonedx-json=sbom.json -q` |
| Confronts | `code` |
| Blocking by default — new project | no — informs |
| Blocking by default — existing project | no — informs |

## Declaring it

```yaml
gates:
  - name: sbom-generated
    on: [code]
    run: "syft scan dir:. -o cyclonedx-json=sbom.json -q"
```

<!-- gate-reference:end -->
